plans.sql: SELECT clock_timestamp() AS clock_timestamp_1

SELECT count(*) AS provisioned, count(*) FILTER (WHERE telemetry_devices.enabled IS true AND anon_1.created_at >= %(created_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND anon_1.created_at <= %(created_at_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS recent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE telemetry_devices.enabled IS false) AS disabled 
FROM telemetry_devices LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (telemetry_outbox.device_id) telemetry_outbox.device_id AS device_id, telemetry_outbox.id AS id, telemetry_outbox.created_at AS created_at, telemetry_outbox.payload AS payload, telemetry_outbox.key_epoch AS key_epoch, telemetry_outbox.sequence_number AS sequence_number 
FROM telemetry_outbox JOIN telemetry_devices ON telemetry_devices.device_id = telemetry_outbox.device_id AND telemetry_devices.key_epoch = telemetry_outbox.key_epoch ORDER BY telemetry_outbox.device_id, telemetry_outbox.created_at DESC) AS anon_1 ON telemetry_devices.device_id = anon_1.device_id

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM live_control_transitions 
WHERE live_control_transitions.phase IN (%(phase_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_1_3)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_1_4)s::VARCHAR) AND live_control_transitions.deadline > %(deadline_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM live_control_transitions 
WHERE live_control_transitions.phase IN (%(phase_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_1_2)s::VARCHAR) OR live_control_transitions.phase IN (%(phase_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_2_2)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_2_3)s::VARCHAR, %(phase_2_4)s::VARCHAR) AND live_control_transitions.deadline <= %(deadline_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

SELECT telemetry_devices.device_id, telemetry_devices.database_device_id, telemetry_devices.topic, telemetry_devices.key_epoch, telemetry_devices.crypto_profile, telemetry_devices.enabled 
FROM telemetry_devices 
WHERE telemetry_devices.device_id = %(device_id_1)s::VARCHAR ORDER BY telemetry_devices.device_id 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER OFFSET %(param_2)s::INTEGER

SELECT live_control_devices.device_id, live_control_devices.key_epoch, live_control_devices.capabilities, live_control_devices.key_fingerprint, live_control_devices.sequence_reserved, live_control_devices.command_sequence, live_control_devices.command_acknowledged, live_control_devices.effective_profile, live_control_devices.reported_profile, live_control_devices.effective_event, live_control_devices.pending_transition, live_control_devices.effective_at, live_control_devices.last_request_at 
FROM live_control_devices 
WHERE live_control_devices.device_id IN (%(device_id_1_1)s::VARCHAR)

SELECT anon_1.device_id, anon_1.id, anon_1.created_at, anon_1.payload, anon_1.key_epoch, anon_1.sequence_number 
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (telemetry_outbox.device_id) telemetry_outbox.device_id AS device_id, telemetry_outbox.id AS id, telemetry_outbox.created_at AS created_at, telemetry_outbox.payload AS payload, telemetry_outbox.key_epoch AS key_epoch, telemetry_outbox.sequence_number AS sequence_number 
FROM telemetry_outbox JOIN telemetry_devices ON telemetry_devices.device_id = telemetry_outbox.device_id AND telemetry_devices.key_epoch = telemetry_outbox.key_epoch ORDER BY telemetry_outbox.device_id, telemetry_outbox.created_at DESC) AS anon_1 
WHERE anon_1.device_id IN (%(device_id_1_1)s::VARCHAR)

SELECT DISTINCT ON (security_observations.device_id) security_observations.id, security_observations.source, security_observations.category, security_observations.device_id, security_observations.key_epoch, security_observations.sequence_number, security_observations.occurred_at 
FROM security_observations 
WHERE security_observations.device_id IN (%(device_id_1_1)s::VARCHAR) AND security_observations.category != %(category_1)s::VARCHAR ORDER BY security_observations.device_id, security_observations.occurred_at DESC

SELECT policy_versions.version, policy_versions.config, policy_versions.sha256, policy_versions.active, policy_versions.created_at

WHERE policy_versions.active IS true

SELECT policy_device_states.device_id, policy_device_states.version, policy_device_states.state, policy_device_states.observed_risk, policy_device_states.recommended, policy_device_states.requested, policy_device_states.applied, policy_device_states.effective_security_state, policy_device_states.configured_profile, policy_device_states.revision, policy_device_states.updated_at

WHERE policy_device_states.device_id IN (%(device_id_1_1)s::VARCHAR) AND policy_device_states.version = %(version_1)s::VARCHAR
